title: Kissed Bouncy Malaysian Chicken Satay
description: This dish features earthy and bouncy chicken satay with a cozy Malaysian twist, using a bain-marie for gentle cooking and Mediterranean-friendly flavors, although hail is not actually used in the recipe as it is not a common or safe ingredient in cooking.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, peanut oil, lime juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, and coriander.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, if using.
Place the skewers in a bain-marie and cook in the preheated oven for 15 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to 400 degrees Fahrenheit and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the satay from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the satay hot with your choice of sides, such as steamed vegetables or rice.
Garnish with fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
